title: A Trustable LSTM-Autoencoder Network for Cyberbullying Detection on Social Media Using Synthetic Data
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical application of deep learning models, including BERT and GPT-2, to classify cyberbullying and aggression. While it mentions that previous studies categorized religious harassment, this specific research benchmarks aggression intensity (Non-Aggressive, Overtly Aggressive, and Covertly Aggressive) and does not evaluate religious, moral, or ethical frameworks.
